topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the framing for the lecture, introducing the core themes of the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition of infection and tissue damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the molecular mechanisms by which pattern recognition receptors detect microbial patterns and cellular damage.

topics.label: Initiation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic inflammatory response
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular events and signaling pathways that drive the recruitment of immune cells and coordinate acute inflammatory responses.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanisms responsible for terminating inflammation, repairing injured tissue, and the consequences of chronic inflammatory states.
